description: Hyperliquid main-dex perps that also have a Hyperliquid spot market (e.g. HYPE, PURR, BTC via UBTC). Returns items[] with base, perp, funding_apr (annualised, now), funding_apr_14d (14-day mean), hours_positive_14d (share of hours with positive funding, 0–1), perp_mark, spot_mark, spot_pair, basis_pct (perp vs spot, %), perp_vol24_usd, spot_vol24_usd, oi_usd, sorted by 14-day funding. Data, not a signal. Requires a Carry key (X-API-KEY), the free trial key, or x402 per call. Use for main-dex perp vs its spot market; for cross-dex HIP-3 pairs use carry_xdex.

min_vol.description: Minimum perp 24h volume in USD, default 100000
